visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot of a glass bowl on a light wooden table containing pinkish raw shredded pork. A pair of hands wearing translucent gloves adds various seasonings from small glass dishes into the bowl. (2) A medium shot features a middle-aged male chef with short black hair, wearing a professional white chef's jacket with a black collar and a microphone attached. He stands in front of a white brick wall, speaking and gesturing with both hands. (3) The scene shifts to a black wok where oil is heated and dark peppercorns are tossed. The peppercorns are then strained out into a glass bowl. (4) The marinated shredded pork is placed into the hot oil in the wok and stirred rapidly with a spatula until it changes color from pink to a cooked brownish-tan. (5) Slices of beige dried tofu are then fried in the wok until their surfaces appear slightly blistered and golden. The tofu is strained out and held in a metal sieve. (6) Aromatics including dried red chili segments, minced garlic, and green onion sections are sautéed in the shimmering oil. (7) The cooked pork and tofu are added back into the wok, followed by a spoonful of thick dark sauce and light seasonings. (8) Fresh green and red chili slices are added to the mixture for a final stir-fry session. (9) The video concludes with an extreme close-up of wooden chopsticks lifting a cluster of glossy pork, a tofu slice, and a vibrant red chili ring against a blurred background.
